# temps_feature_flag (Resource)

A project feature flag. Set per-environment values and kill switches with `temps_feature_flag_environment`.

Temps never hard-deletes flags: destroying this resource archives the flag, and its key stays reserved. Creating a flag whose key belongs to an archived flag of the same `value_type` restores that flag, clears its old environment overrides and applies this configuration. Changing `key` or `value_type` therefore needs a new key: Temps cannot reuse an archived key for a different type.

Import with `<project_id>/<key>`.

Required API key permissions: `flags:read`, `flags:write`, `flags:delete`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "temps_feature_flag" "new_checkout" {
  project_id    = temps_project.web.id
  key           = "new-checkout"
  value_type    = "bool"
  default_value = jsonencode(false)
  description   = "Serve the redesigned checkout"
}

resource "temps_feature_flag" "checkout_limits" {
  project_id    = temps_project.web.id
  key           = "checkout.limits"
  value_type    = "json"
  default_value = jsonencode({ max_items = 50, currencies = ["EUR", "USD"] })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `default_value` (String) JSON-encoded value served when nothing more specific applies, for example `jsonencode(false)`. Compared semantically, so key order and number formatting never show as changes.
- `key` (String) Key used in application code: lower-case letters, digits, `.`, `_` and `-`, starting with a letter or digit, at most 128 characters.
- `project_id` (Number) ID of the project.
- `value_type` (String) `bool`, `string`, `number` or `json`. Fixed once created.

### Optional

- `client_visible` (Boolean) Whether browsers may evaluate the flag through the public endpoint. Defaults to `false`.
- `description` (String) What the flag controls.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<project_id>/<key>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import temps_feature_flag.new_checkout 3/new-checkout
```
